ms.criteria:
・ Learning sessions were conducted on relevant topics in accordance with the plan.
・Document of Evidence that each learning club has conducted a total of 4 coaching sessions on relevant Cardano topics.
・Document of the topics covered during these coaching sessions.
・Survey is conducted and answered by all the students
・Document of the Submission of at least one well-prepared project proposal from each of the 10 established clubs.
・Materials and resources used during the learning sessions are available and organized.
ms.report:
Hello reviewers, and thank you very much for getting back to us.
About the learning resources created by trainers in french through the referenced links, we have asked the trainers to upload them. We asked trainers to work together in a google meet session, and to put their resources together and put them in google drive. Here is the link to the google drive : 
--> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kGlWwC-GUS2v-S3tPzknH0eLWF2ztosN?usp=sharing

We also have reference links of all the resources produced in french on our french community platform. Here is the Google sheet with all the links :
--> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LljBjIqDQZZK6wq8whCJH_RP-0TV6iuQVaShZ15uqdY/edit?usp=sharing
The trainers are all bilingual, so they didn’t have any problem translating the ressources from english to french.

We also asked students to make their projects more clear for reviewers by adding Objectives, implementation plans and expected outcomes. Every project is name like this : Town_GroupLeader. Here is the link to the Google drive with the student projects :
--> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rDJ_YglN2PxKEXwlVVyGVhf6ma6HbSaB?usp=sharing

Please let us know if there’s something else we should add for the achievement of this milestone, The trainers team and the students are very pleased to give more information. Thank you.
